notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These 2 were picked from the cb_bbkc_nq_v3_15m and cb_bbkc_nq_v3_5m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, stability, correlation with each other) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice (the grid itself was fixed before any NQ 2023–2024 squeeze result). It shows the strategies held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First squeeze-breakout look at the NQ holdout. No compression-breakout strategy had been scored on NQ 2025 onward before this. Only these 2, frozen beforehand, were run (each also scored alone by the funnel's final-test the same day), so there's no selection among holdout results. The mean-reversion and noise-band families were scored on NQ 2025+ earlier (different strategies: the mean-reversion pair lost, the noise-band pair made +10%), so the researcher has seen how that period treated them.
